collection.description: Children invent a frightening legend about a weathered totem near a familiar path.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Children invent a frightening legend about a weathered totem near a familiar path.

choices.label: Turn the Legend into a Game

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The carving commemorates an ordinary harvest celebration.

text_only.reason: a celebration talked about or planned in the story; nobody celebrates in the game -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Different caretakers recall conflicting stories, and the mystery remains.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (craftsperson), a craftsperson, identifies repairs from several generations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The children discover their imagined monster is a badly worn bird.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A playful storytelling contest produces hilarious monsters.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One child becomes genuinely frightened, and the group chooses a gentler game.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers accept that not every symbol has one interpretation.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder) insists on an old explanation while admitting no one can prove it.
